how_it_works: TR2[name] = (fn(A, B, j, f, sa, sb), pre, post). A = outgoing frame, B = incoming frame, j = frames relative to the cut (negative before it), f = timeline frame, sa/sb = shot dicts. The incoming shot sets tin='name' in the EDL; the renderer calls fn for j in [-pre, post).
